Tarefa: refazer do zero o painel "escritório virtual" do cuidar.vc em novo estilo visual. Você vai criar o arquivo NOVO em /home/hermes/painel-web/escritorio-v4.html. NÃO toque em index.html (está no ar).

1) PRIMEIRO DE TUDO: leia a imagem referencia.jpg deste diretório com a ferramenta Read. Ela é a referência visual exata do estilo que o dono quer. Depois leia o index.html atual: o motor de movimento JS e os dados são bons, reaproveite as ideias.

2) ESTILO ALVO (igual à referência, mas mais realista ainda): escritório em perspectiva 3D (CSS 3D puro, sem canvas):
- piso de tábuas de madeira clara (veios via repeating-linear-gradient)
- parede de fundo de tijolos com vigas de madeira escuras (padrão de tijolos)
- janela grande de múltiplos vidros na parede, brilhando com luz do dia
- lâmpadas pendentes de bulbo amarelado penduradas em fios em alturas variadas
- letreiro neon na parede do fundo: "CUIDAR.VC" em neon dourado e embaixo "cuidado com que cuida" em neon ciano (glow via text-shadow)
- rack de servidor preto alto com fileiras de LEDs verdes
- plantas em vasos espalhadas pelo escritório
- cada estação de trabalho com mesa sólida 3D, monitor(es) ligados mostrando conteúdo, cadeira, papéis, caneca, livros
- iluminação quente e aconchegante: sombras suaves, luz amarelada, brilho nas janelas

3) ELENCO: 13 membros, todos do cuidar.vc, cada um com mesa própria e plaquinha:
- Rob (fundador, coroa): sala de vidro separada no canto direito, mesa executiva grande
- Tech: CTO, Dev, QA, DevOps. O DevOps fica perto do rack de servidor com LEDs
- Marketing: CMO, Claudete, e a squad de conteúdo numa mesa comprida: Planejador, Copy, Artes, QC, Agendador, Métricas

4) FUNCIONALIDADES (obrigatórias):
- agentes se movem sozinhos pela sala (motor com pontos de interesse), alternando entre andar e trabalhar sentados digitando
- cada mesa com plaquinha flutuante legível: nome + função. Nenhuma plaquinha pode sobrepor outra nem cortar texto
- balão de fala ocasional com frase curta de trabalho (PT-BR, sem travessão)
- página organizada: header limpo (logo cuidar.vc, relógio ao vivo), cena como destaque, seção abaixo com iframe src="/dash-proxy/" com título "Painel do CMO", footer discreto
- responsivo: em 390px de largura a cena inteira aparece sem cortes (escala automática); botão de ampliar que libera pan por arrastar

5) REGRAS:
- arquivo único HTML, zero dependências externas (sem CDN, sem imagens externas, sem fontes externas)
- zero erro de JavaScript no console
- todo texto visível em PT-BR e JAMAIS travessão (—) em nenhum texto
- código e comentários podem ser em inglês

CRITÉRIO DE PRONTO: escritorio-v4.html salvo e completo; ao abrir no browser mostra o escritório no estilo da referência, 13 agentes andando e trabalhando, plaquinhas 100% legíveis sem sobreposição, iframe do CMO presente, sem erro de console, sem cortar em 390px.

Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use a 1-hour Anthropic prompt-cache TTL, so effectively every allowed delay (the runtime clamps to [60, 3600]) wakes up with your conversation context still cached. There is no cache cliff inside that range to pace around, and scheduling extra wakeups just to keep the cache warm is pure waste — never do that. (If the session enters usage overage, later requests drop to the 5-minute TTL; don't try to track or preempt that — the guidance here stays the same.)

Match the delay to what you're actually waiting for:

- **Actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about** (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue): pick the delay from how fast that state actually changes. A CI run that takes ~8 minutes deserves one ~480s check, not eight 60s ones.
- **The long fallback heartbeat** (something else — a Monitor, a task notification — is the primary wake signal): 1200s+, so quiet wakeups stay rare.
- **Idle ticks with no specific signal to watch**: default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop still checks back regularly, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Don't think in cache windows — think about what you're actually waiting for.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Painel do escritório (estático) + proxy /dash/* -> localhost:8800 (prefixo /dash removido, como o Caddy faz).
# A chave k é injetada aqui no servidor: nunca aparece no HTML que vai pro navegador.
import http.server, urllib.request, urllib.error, os, re

ROOT = '/home/hermes/painel-web'
KEY = '6a50de16401166fc3c52052242b612c3'
UP = 'http://127.0.0.1:8800'
INJECT_FROM = b"new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('k')||''"
INJECT_TO = b"'" + KEY.encode() + b"'"

class H(http.server.BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    protocol_version = 'HTTP/1.1'

    def _static(self):
        path = self.path.split('?')[0]
        if path == '/':
            path = '/index.html'
        f = os.path.normpath(ROOT + path)
        if not f.startswith(ROOT) or not os.path.isfile(f):
            self.send_error(404, 'arquivo'); return
        data = open(f, 'rb').read()
        ct = 'text/html; charset=utf-8' if f.endswith('.html') else 'application/octet-stream'
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ct)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(data)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(data)

    def _proxy(self):
        rest = self.path[len('/dash'):] or '/'
        if '?' in rest:
            url = UP + rest
        else:
            url = UP + rest + '?k=' + KEY
        if not re.search(r'[?&]k=', url):
            url += '&k=' + KEY
        req = urllib.request.Request(url, method=self.command)
        ln = int(self.headers.get('Content-Length') or 0)
        if ln:
            req.data = self.rfile.read(ln)
        if self.headers.get('Content-Type'):
            req.add_header('Content-Type', self.headers['Content-Type'])
        try:
            r = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20)
            body, code, hdrs = r.read(), r.status, r.headers
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            body, code, hdrs = e.read(), e.code, e.headers
        except Exception as ex:
            self.send_error(502, str(ex)); return
        ct = hdrs.get('Content-Type', 'text/plain')
        if 'html' in ct and INJECT_FROM in body:
            body = body.replace(INJECT_FROM, INJECT_TO, 1)
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header('Content-Type', ct)
        self.send_header('Content-Length', str(len(body)))
        self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store')
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def _route(self):
        if self.path.split('?')[0].startswith('/dash'):
            self._proxy()
        else:
            self._static()

    def do_GET(self): self._route()
    def do_POST(self): self._route()
    def do_HEAD(self): self._route()
    def log_message(self, format, *args): pass

/* rack */
.rack>.f.t{background:#141517}
.rack>.f.w,.rack>.f.e{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#101113 0 6px,#1b1c20 6px 8px)}
.rack>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0b0c0e,#1b1d21 50%,#0b0c0e);padding:10px 6px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}
.rack .u{position:relative;flex:1;border-radius:2px;background:linear-gradient(#26282e,#15161a);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #33363d}
.rack .u::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:5px;top:50%;margin-top:-2px;width:34px;height:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#4ade80 0 1.7px,#0000 2.2px) 0 0/7px 4px repeat-x;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px #4ade80);animation:led 1.1s steps(2) infinite}

.rack .u:nth-child(3n)::before{animation-duration:1.7s}
.rack .u:nth-child(4n)::before{animation-duration:.5s}
.rack .u:nth-child(5n)::after{animation-duration:2.3s;background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#fbbf24 0 1.7px,#0000 2.2px)}

 {id:'plan',n:'Planejador',r:'Pauta de posts',c:'#0e7490',p:'#334155',hc:'#1f2937',sk:'#f2c49b',hair:'short',spd:80,work:['pauta da semana fechada','tema de amanhã definido','calendário atualizado'],scr:'cal'},

function buildDesk(a){
 var d=a.desk,cx=d.x+d.w/2;
 fshadow(d.x,d.y,d.w,d.d);
 a.seat=[cx,d.y-22];
 chair(cx,a.seat[1],d.exec);
 var B=box(world,d.x,d.y,d.w,d.d,d.h,'desk'+(d.exec?' walnut':''));
 var t=B.t,w=d.w;
 monitor(t,w*.2,36,d.scr[0],{rz:10});
 monitor(t,w*.8,36,d.scr[1],{rz:-10});
 mk(t,'kb','left:'+(w/2-23)+'px;top:44px;width:46px');
 mk(t,'mouse','left:'+(w/2+32)+'px;top:46px');
 paper(t,18,52,-12);paper(t,34,56,8,24,30);
 if(d.exec){plane(t,w-16,30,30,46,'dlamp',{center:true,z:.5});books(t,w-70,70);mug(t,w-26,78,'red')}
 else{books(t,w-52,62);mug(t,w-16,76,a.id==='dev'?'teal':'')}
 a.plateAt=[cx,a.seat[1],d.exec?190:176];
}
var squad=TEAM.slice(7);
var TX=150,TY=662,TW=900,TD=80,TH=46;
fshadow(TX,TY,TW,TD);
squad.forEach(function(a,i){a.seat=[TX+75+i*150,TY-22];chair(a.seat[0],a.seat[1],false)});
var table=box(world,TX,TY,TW,TD,TH,'desk');
squad.forEach(function(a,i){
 var lx=75+i*150;
 monitor(table.t,lx+54,34,a.scr,a.lap?{lap:true,w:52,h:34,rz:-14}:{rz:-12});
 mk(table.t,'kb','left:'+(lx-21)+'px;top:40px;width:42px');
 paper(table.t,lx-62,40,-10+i*4);
 if(i%2)mug(table.t,lx-40,70,i%4===1?'teal':'');else books(table.t,lx-58,62);
 a.exit=[[a.seat[0],575]];a.aisle=575;
 a.plateAt=[a.seat[0],a.seat[1],166];
});
TEAM.slice(0,7).forEach(buildDesk);

// Plants and pendant lamps
plant(40,120,40,'');plant(600,52,34,'terra');plant(1168,60,36,'snake');plant(1168,300,34,'');
plant(40,700,42,'terra');plant(44,862,46,'');plant(1166,860,44,'snake');plant(882,520,34,'');
plant(300,850,38,'');plant(890,860,36,'terra');
function lamp(x,y,z){plane(world,x,y,120,760,'lamp',{center:true,z:z-64}).innerHTML='<i class="halo"></i><i class="wire"></i><i class="cap"></i><i class="bulb"></i>'}
[[180,210,300],[270,160,350],[470,150,320],[610,230,370],[740,190,300],[1060,160,330],[300,500,390],[860,520,410]].forEach(function(l){lamp(l[0],l[1],l[2])});

/* ---------------- agents ---------------- */
function buildAgent(a,i){
 var el=mk(world,'agent sit h-'+(a.hair||'short')+(a.acc?' a-'+a.acc:''));
 el.style.setProperty('--c',a.c);el.style.setProperty('--p',a.p);el.style.setProperty('--hc',a.hc);el.style.setProperty('--sk',a.sk);el.style.setProperty('--bd',(Math.random()*4).toFixed(2)+'s');
 el.innerHTML='<i class="ash"></i><div class="fig" title="'+a.n+'"><div class="bw"><i class="leg l"></i><i class="leg r"></i><i class="arm l"></i><i class="arm r"></i><i class="torso"></i><div class="head"><i class="hair"></i><i class="eye l"></i><i class="eye r"></i><i class="mouth"></i><i class="blush"></i></div>'+(a.acc==='crown'?'<i class="crown"></i>':'')+'<i class="hanc"></i></div></div>';
 a.el=el;a.anc=el.querySelector('.hanc');a.x=a.seat[0];a.y=a.seat[1];a.path=null;a.away=false;a.cur=a.work[0];
 place(a);
 el.querySelector('.fig').addEventListener('click',function(ev){ev.stopPropagation();say(a,'agora: '+a.cur,4200)});
 var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='bub';hud.appendChild(b);a.bub=b;
}
function place(a){a.el.style.transform='translate3d('+a.x.toFixed(1)+'px,'+a.y.toFixed(1)+'px,0)'}
function pose(a,p){a.el.classList.remove('walk','sit','idle');a.el.classList.add(p);if(p!=='walk')a.el.classList.remove('back')}

/* ---------------- plates (2D overlay, collision free) ---------------- */
var plates=[];
function buildPlates(){
 TEAM.forEach(function(a){
  var el=document.createElement('div');el.className='plate'+(a.boss?' boss':'');
  el.innerHTML='<b>'+a.n+'</b><span>'+a.r+'</span>';hud.appendChild(el);
  var anc=mk(world,'','left:'+a.plateAt[0]+'px;top:'+a.plateAt[1]+'px;width:2px;height:2px;transform:translateZ('+a.plateAt[2]+'px)');
  plates.push({el:el,anc:anc});
 });
}
function vpRect(){var r=vp.getBoundingClientRect();return {l:r.left,t:r.top,s:r.width/SW}}
function project(node,R){var r=node.getBoundingClientRect();return [(r.left+r.width/2-R.l)/R.s,(r.top+r.height/2-R.t)/R.s]}
function layoutPlates(){
 var R=vpRect();if(!R.s)return;
 var GAP=6,items=plates.map(function(p){var q=project(p.anc,R),w=p.el.offsetWidth,h=p.el.offsetHeight;return {p:p,ax:q[0],ay:q[1],w:w,h:h,x:q[0]-w/2,y:q[1]-h}});
 function clamp(it){it.x=Math.max(6,Math.min(SW-6-it.w,it.x));it.y=Math.max(6,Math.min(SH-6-it.h,it.y))}
 items.forEach(clamp);
 for(var k=0;k<300;k++){
  var moved=false;
  for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++)for(var j=i+1;j<items.length;j++){
   var A=items[i],B=items[j];
   var ox=Math.min(A.x+A.w,B.x+B.w)-Math.max(A.x,B.x)+GAP,oy=Math.min(A.y+A.h,B.y+B.h)-Math.max(A.y,B.y)+GAP;
   if(ox>0&&oy>0){moved=true;
    if(ox<oy){var dx=ox/2+.01;if(A.x+A.w/2<B.x+B.w/2){A.x-=dx;B.x+=dx}else{A.x+=dx;B.x-=dx}}
    else{var dy=oy/2+.01;if(A.y+A.h/2<B.y+B.h/2){A.y-=dy;B.y+=dy}else{A.y+=dy;B.y-=dy}}
    clamp(A);clamp(B);
   }
  }
  if(!moved)break;
 }
 var svg='';
 items.forEach(function(it){
  it.p.el.style.transform='translate('+it.x.toFixed(1)+'px,'+it.y.toFixed(1)+'px)';it.p.el.classList.add('on');
  var bx=it.x+it.w/2,by=it.y+it.h,ty=it.ay+14;
  svg+='<line x1="'+bx.toFixed(1)+'" y1="'+by.toFixed(1)+'" x2="'+it.ax.toFixed(1)+'" y2="'+ty.toFixed(1)+'"/><circle cx="'+it.ax.toFixed(1)+'" cy="'+ty.toFixed(1)+'" r="2"/>';
 });
 stems.innerHTML=svg;
}

/* ---------------- speech ---------------- */
var talking=[];
function say(a,text,dur){
 a.bub.innerHTML='<b>'+a.n+'</b>'+text;a.bub.classList.add('on');
 if(talking.indexOf(a)<0)talking.push(a);
 posBub(a,vpRect());
 clearTimeout(a.bt);a.bt=setTimeout(function(){a.bub.classList.remove('on');setTimeout(function(){if(!a.bub.classList.contains('on')){var k=talking.indexOf(a);if(k>=0)talking.splice(k,1)}},320)},dur||3800);
}
function posBub(a,R){
 var q=project(a.anc,R),w=a.bub.offsetWidth,h=a.bub.offsetHeight;
 var x=Math.max(6,Math.min(SW-6-w,q[0]-w/2)),y=Math.max(6,q[1]-h-10);
 a.bub.style.left=x.toFixed(1)+'px';a.bub.style.top=y.toFixed(1)+'px';
 a.bub.style.setProperty('--tx',Math.max(12,Math.min(w-12,q[0]-x)).toFixed(1)+'px');
}

/* ---------------- movement engine ---------------- */
var CORR=[322,610];
var POI=[
 {pt:[92,548],aisle:575,ax:92,lines:['pausa pro café','esse café tá ótimo','alguém quer café?']},
 {pt:[322,76],aisle:300,ax:322,lines:['água gelada, que delícia','hidratar é importante']},
 {pt:[230,56],aisle:300,ax:322,pre:[[322,56]],lines:['que dia bonito lá fora','olhando o movimento da rua']},
 {pt:[852,124],aisle:300,ax:852,lines:['conferindo os servidores','tudo verde no rack']},
 {pt:[64,300],aisle:300,ax:64,lines:['procurando aquele livro','boa leitura essa']},
 {pt:[1078,690],aisle:575,ax:1078,lines:['pausa de cinco minutos','ideia boa surgindo aqui']},
 {pt:[1150,500],aisle:575,ax:1150,lines:['metas da semana conferidas','anotando no quadro']}
];
var VISIT=['bora alinhar rapidinho?','me ajuda com isso?','olha esse resultado','tem um minuto?','ficou ótimo, viu?'];
var REPLY=['claro, pode falar','boa ideia!','vou ver agora','combinado','te mando já já','bora!'];
function visitSpot(b){
 if(b.desk){var d=b.desk,front=d.y+d.d+24;return {pt:[b.seat[0]+rand(-30,30),front],aisle:front<300?300:575,ax:null,host:b}}
 var ex=b.seat[0]<600?118:1080;return {pt:[b.seat[0]+rand(-20,20),772],aisle:575,ax:ex,pre:[[ex,772]],host:b};
}
function route(a,dest){
 var pts=a.exit.map(function(p){return p.slice()}),my=a.aisle,last=pts[pts.length-1];
 var ax=dest.ax==null?dest.pt[0]:dest.ax;
 if(dest.aisle!==my){
  var mid=(last[0]+ax)/2,cx=Math.abs(CORR[0]-mid)<Math.abs(CORR[1]-mid)?CORR[0]:CORR[1];
  pts.push([cx,my],[cx,dest.aisle]);
 }
 pts.push([ax,dest.aisle]);
 (dest.pre||[]).forEach(function(p){pts.push(p.slice())});
 pts.push(dest.pt.slice());
 return pts;
}
function walk(a,pts){return new Promise(function(res){a.path=pts;a.done=res;pose(a,'walk')})}
var last=performance.now();
function tick(now){
 var dt=Math.min(.05,(now-last)/1000);last=now;
 for(var i=0;i<TEAM.length;i++){
  var a=TEAM[i];if(!a.path)continue;
  var t=a.path[0],dx=t[0]-a.x,dy=t[1]-a.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy),step=a.spd*dt;
  if(dist<=step){a.x=t[0];a.y=t[1];a.path.shift();if(!a.path.length){a.path=null;var r=a.done;a.done=null;if(r)r()}}
  else{a.x+=dx/dist*step;a.y+=dy/dist*step;
   if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)){a.el.classList.toggle('flip',dx<0);a.el.classList.remove('back')}
   else a.el.classList.toggle('back',dy<0);
  }
  place(a);
 }
 if(talking.length){var R=vpRect();talking.forEach(function(a){posBub(a,R)})}
 requestAnimationFrame(tick);
}
var awayCount=0;
async function life(a,delay){
 await sleep(delay);
 for(;;){
  pose(a,'sit');
  if(Math.random()<.6){a.cur=pick(a.work);say(a,a.cur)}
  await sleep(rand(6000,15000));
  if(awayCount>=5||Math.random()<.3)continue;
  awayCount++;a.away=true;
  var dest,host=null;
  if(Math.random()<.45){
   var others=TEAM.filter(function(b){return b!==a&&!b.away});
   dest=visitSpot(pick(others));host=dest.host;
  }else dest=pick(POI);
  var jit=dest.host?0:rand(-12,12);dest={pt:[dest.pt[0]+jit,dest.pt[1]],aisle:dest.aisle,ax:dest.ax,pre:dest.pre,lines:dest.lines,host:dest.host};
  var pts=route(a,dest);
  a.cur=host?'conversando com '+host.n:'dando uma pausa';
  await walk(a,pts);
  pose(a,'idle');a.el.classList.remove('flip');
  if(host){say(a,pick(VISIT));if(!host.away)setTimeout(function(){say(host,pick(REPLY))},1600)}
  else say(a,pick(dest.lines));
  await sleep(rand(3800,6500));
  var backPts=pts.slice(0,-1).reverse();backPts.push(a.seat.slice());
  await walk(a,backPts);
  a.el.classList.remove('flip');
  a.away=false;awayCount--;
 }
}

/* ---------------- clock ---------------- */
var hh=wclock.querySelector('.hh'),mm=wclock.querySelector('.mm'),ss=wclock.querySelector('.ss');
function clock(){
 var d=new Date(),tz='America/Sao_Paulo';
 $('clock').textContent=d.toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{timeZone:tz});
 $('dateTxt').textContent=d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{timeZone:tz,weekday:'short',day:'2-digit',month:'short'}).replace(/\./g,'');
 var p=d.toLocaleTimeString('en-GB',{timeZone:tz,hour12:false}).split(':').map(Number);
 hh.style.transform='rotate('+((p[0]%12)*30+p[1]*.5)+'deg)';mm.style.transform='rotate('+(p[1]*6)+'deg)';ss.style.transform='rotate('+(p[2]*6)+'deg)';
}

/* ---------------- fit, zoom and pan ---------------- */
var fitwrap=$('fitwrap'),scenebox=$('scenebox'),zoomBtn=$('zoomBtn'),zoomed=false;
function fit(){
 var avail=fitwrap.clientWidth||SW;
 if(zoomed){
  scenebox.style.transform='none';
  fitwrap.style.height=Math.min(SH,Math.max(320,Math.round(window.innerHeight*.72)))+'px';
 }else{
  var s=Math.min(1,avail/SW);
  scenebox.style.transform='scale('+s+')';
  fitwrap.style.height=Math.round(SH*s)+'px';
  fitwrap.scrollLeft=0;fitwrap.scrollTop=0;
 }
 // spacer so the scroll area matches the unscaled scene when zoomed
 scenebox.style.position=zoomed?'relative':'absolute';
}
zoomBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){
 zoomed=!zoomed;fitwrap.classList.toggle('zoomed',zoomed);
 zoomBtn.textContent=zoomed?'Ajustar à tela':'Ampliar';
 $('hint').textContent=zoomed?'Arraste a cena para navegar pelo escritório':'Toque em um agente para ver o que ele está fazendo';
 fit();
 if(zoomed){fitwrap.scrollLeft=(SW-fitwrap.clientWidth)/2;fitwrap.scrollTop=(SH-fitwrap.clientHeight)/2}
});
var drag=null;
fitwrap.addEventListener('pointerdown',function(e){if(!zoomed)return;drag={x:e.clientX,y:e.clientY,l:fitwrap.scrollLeft,t:fitwrap.scrollTop,moved:false};fitwrap.classList.add('dragging');try{fitwrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
fitwrap.addEventListener('pointermove',function(e){if(!drag)return;var dx=e.clientX-drag.x,dy=e.clientY-drag.y;if(Math.abs(dx)+Math.abs(dy)>3)drag.moved=true;fitwrap.scrollLeft=drag.l-dx;fitwrap.scrollTop=drag.t-dy});
function endDrag(){if(!drag)return;drag=null;fitwrap.classList.remove('dragging')}
fitwrap.addEventListener('pointerup',endDrag);fitwrap.addEventListener('pointercancel',endDrag);
var rt;window.addEventListener('resize',function(){fit();clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(layoutPlates,150)});

/* ---------------- boot ---------------- */
buildPlates();
TEAM.forEach(buildAgent);
fit();clock();setInterval(clock,1000);
requestAnimationFrame(function(){requestAnimationFrame(function(){layoutPlates();setTimeout(layoutPlates,600)})});
requestAnimationFrame(tick);
TEAM.forEach(function(a,i){life(a,i<4?rand(600,2500):rand(2000,12000))});
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-width:0}
.logo{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#ffd27a,#e98a3b);display:grid;place-items:center;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(233,138,59,.35)}
.logo i{position:relative;width:14px;height:14px;background:#fff;transform:rotate(45deg) translate(2px,2px);border-radius:2px}
.logo i::before,.logo i::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:14px;height:14px;background:#fff;border-radius:50%}
.logo i::before{left:-7px;top:0}.logo i::after{left:0;top:-7px}
.wordmark{font-size:21px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.3px;color:#fff4e2}
.wordmark b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:800}
.brand .sep{width:1px;height:22px;background:#4a3726}
.brand .sub{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap}
.hr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.live{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;font-size:12px;color:#cfe9d8;background:#15251b;border:1px solid #2c5a3c;border-radius:20px;padding:5px 11px;white-space:nowrap}
.live i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:#4ade80;box-shadow:0 0 8px #4ade80;animation:pulse 1.8s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.35}}
.clock{font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;font-size:13px;background:#21170f;border:1px solid #3d2d1f;border-radius:10px;padding:5px 11px;white-space:nowrap}
.clock b{color:var(--gold);font-weight:700;margin-right:6px}
main{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px 12px 0}
.stage-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.stage-head h1{font-size:20px;font-weight:750;color:#fff2de}
.stage-head p{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:2px}
.btn{font:600 13px system-ui,sans-serif;color:#1c130b;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffd48a,#e9a54b);border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 14px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(233,165,75,.3);white-space:nowrap}
.btn:active{transform:translateY(1px)}
.fitwrap{position:relative;width:100%;overflow:hidden;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.6),0 0 0 1px #3a2a1c}
.fitwrap.zoomed{cursor:grab;touch-action:none}
.fitwrap.dragging{cursor:grabbing}
.scenebox{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1200px;height:780px;transform-origin:0 0}
.hint{font-size:12px;color:#8e7c69;text-align:center;margin:10px 0 0}
.dash{margin:30px 0 0}
.dash-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:10px}
.dash-head h2{font-size:18px;color:#fff2de}
.dash-head a{font-size:12px;color:var(--gold);text-decoration:none;border:1px solid #6b4f2c;border-radius:9px;padding:6px 11px;white-space:nowrap}
.dash iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:900px;border:0;border-radius:16px;background:#15100b;box-shadow:0 16px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.45),0 0 0 1px #3a2a1c}
@media(max-width:640px){.dash iframe{height:1100px}.brand .sep,.brand .sub{display:none}.top{padding:9px 12px}.stage-head h1{font-size:17px}}
footer{max-width:1240px;margin:28px auto 0;padding:16px 12px 22px;border-top:1px solid #2a1f16;font-size:12px;color:#7d6c5b;text-align:center}

/* ---------- 3D scene ---------- */
.viewport{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1200px;height:780px;overflow:hidden;perspective:1600px;perspective-origin:50% 16%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#120b07 0%,#24160d 40%,#2d1c10 100%)}
.world{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:1200px;height:900px;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform-origin:50% 0;transform:translateY(262px) translateZ(-900px) rotateX(var(--tilt))}
.world div,.world i{position:absolute}
.b,.v{transform-style:preserve-3d}
.f{backface-visibility:hidden}
.f.t{left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;transform:translateZ(var(--h));transform-style:preserve-3d}
.f.s{left:0;top:calc(100% - var(--h));width:100%;height:var(--h);transform-origin:50% 100%;transform:rotateX(-90deg)}
.f.w{left:0;top:0;width:var(--h);height:100%;transform-origin:0 50%;transform:rotateY(-90deg)}
.f.e{left:calc(100% - var(--h));top:0;width:var(--h);height:100%;transform-origin:100% 50%;transform:rotateY(90deg)}
.v{pointer-events:none}

/* floor: light oak planks running toward the viewer */
.floor{background-color:#d5a974;background-image:
 linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(60,30,10,.34),rgba(60,30,10,0) 30%,rgba(255,220,170,.10) 62%,rgba(60,30,10,.22)),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 2px,#0000 75%,rgba(90,52,22,.55) 0),
 linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(85,50,20,.6) 0 2px,rgba(255,236,200,.18) 2px 3px,#0000 3px),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(120,70,30,.13) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(255,230,190,.10) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 48px 100%,#0000 75%,rgba(100,55,20,.09) 0),
 repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 5px,rgba(120,75,35,.13) 5px 6px,#0000 6px 13px,rgba(255,235,205,.10) 13px 14px,#0000 14px 23px,rgba(110,65,30,.10) 23px 24px,#0000 24px 31px),
 repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 2px,rgba(90,55,25,.07) 2px 3px,#0000 3px 9px);
 background-size:100% 100%,96px 250px,144px 310px,240px 190px,48px 100%,144px 100%,240px 100%,336px 100%,48px 100%,17px 100%;
 background-position:0 0,0 0,48px 120px,96px 60px,0 0,0 0,96px 0,192px 0,0 0,0 0}
.floor i{pointer-events:none}
.sun{background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,238,190,.34),rgba(255,230,170,0));filter:blur(6px)}
.pool{border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,196,110,.30),rgba(255,180,90,0))}
.fs{border-radius:14px;background:rgba(40,20,6,.32);filter:blur(7px)}

/* bricks */
.wall{--m:#4d2a1b;background-color:#8f4b2f;background-image:
 linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,6,2,.62),rgba(15,6,2,.1) 26%,rgba(255,190,120,.05) 55%,rgba(15,6,2,.38)),
 conic-gradient(at 3px 21px,#0000 75%,var(--m) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 3px 21px,#0000 75%,var(--m) 0),
 linear-gradient(#0000 18px,var(--m) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(0,0,0,.16) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(255,170,110,.10) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(40,10,0,.18) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(190,110,60,.16) 0),
 conic-gradient(at 66px 21px,#0000 75%,rgba(0,0,0,.10) 0);
 background-size:100% 100%,66px 42px,66px 42px,66px 21px,198px 63px,264px 84px,330px 105px,462px 126px,396px 147px;
 background-position:0 0,0 0,33px 21px,0 0,0 0,33px 21px,132px 42px,99px 63px,264px 0}
.wall::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:14px;background:linear-gradient(#3a2415,#23150c)}
.wall.side{filter:brightness(.82)}
.beam{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1f130b,#4a3020 25%,#3d2718 60%,#1c110a);box-shadow:5px 0 14px rgba(0,0,0,.5),-3px 0 10px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.beam.h{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4b3120,#2d1c11 70%,#1c110a);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.brace{height:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#4b3120,#2a190f);box-shadow:0 5px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.45);transform-origin:0 50%}

/* windows */
.win{border:9px solid #2c1c12;border-radius:3px;background:#2c1c12;display:grid;gap:6px;box-shadow:0 0 50px 12px rgba(255,226,160,.30),inset 0 0 0 2px #1a0f08;overflow:hidden}
.win span{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#bfe6ff 0%,#eaf8ff 55%,#fff6d6 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.win span::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(125deg,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 12%,#0000 12% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.25) 30% 36%,#0000 36%)}
.win .sky{position:absolute;inset:9px;pointer-events:none;background:radial-gradient(60px 40px at 78% 22%,rgba(255,250,215,.95),rgba(255,240,180,0))}
.win::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:-12px;right:-12px;bottom:-12px;height:12px;background:#3a2517}
.sill{height:12px;background:linear-gradient(#5a3a24,#2d1c11);box-shadow:0 8px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}

/* neon */
.neon{text-align:center;pointer-events:none}
.neon .n1{font:800 76px/1 "Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:6px;color:#fff6d8;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff,0 0 7px #ffe08a,0 0 16px #ffc13b,0 0 32px #ff9f1a,0 0 60px #ff8a00,0 0 90px rgba(255,138,0,.6);animation:flick 7s infinite}
.neon .n2{font:600 29px/1.2 "Trebuchet MS","Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;letter-spacing:2px;margin-top:12px;color:#effeff;text-shadow:0 0 2px #fff,0 0 6px #8ff7ff,0 0 14px #2de2f5,0 0 28px #00c8e8,0 0 52px #00a5d8}
.neon::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:-60px;right:-60px;top:-40px;bottom:-40px;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,170,60,.22),rgba(255,170,60,0));z-index:-1}
@keyframes flick{0%,40%,44%,100%{opacity:1}42%{opacity:.72}43%{opacity:.95}}

/* pendant lamps */
.lamp .wire{left:59px;top:0;width:2px;height:calc(100% - 78px);background:#15100c}
.lamp .cap{left:52px;bottom:70px;width:16px;height:12px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a2c20,#8a6a45 45%,#2b2017);border-radius:3px 3px 1px 1px}
.lamp .bulb{left:48px;bottom:44px;width:24px;height:28px;border-radius:50% 50% 48% 48%/58% 58% 42% 42%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 45% 42%,#fffbe8 0 18%,#ffe39a 38%,#ffb54a 80%);box-shadow:0 0 18px 6px rgba(255,196,90,.75),0 0 44px 16px rgba(255,170,60,.35)}
.lamp .halo{left:-30px;bottom:-22px;width:180px;height:160px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,rgba(255,200,110,.30),rgba(255,180,80,0))}

/* furniture */
.desk>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,240,215,.20),rgba(0,0,0,0) 45%,rgba(60,30,10,.18)),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 9px,rgba(120,70,30,.10) 9px 10px,#0000 10px 23px),#c89462;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #a97443,inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,235,200,.35)}
.desk>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b37d4c 0 7px,#7e5330 7px 9px,#946238 9px),#8e5d35;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.desk>.f.s::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:14px;width:58px;bottom:6px;border-radius:2px;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#a06b40 0 calc(33.3% - 2px),#5c3a20 calc(33.3% - 2px) 33.3%);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #5c3a20}
.desk>.f.s::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:8px;top:14px;width:58px;bottom:6px;border-radius:2px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#e9c68b 0 2px,#0000 2.5px),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 70%,#e9c68b 0 2px,#0000 2.5px),#a06b40;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #5c3a20}
.desk>.f.w,.desk>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#6e4626,#835530)}
.desk.walnut>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,230,200,.18),rgba(0,0,0,0) 45%,rgba(0,0,0,.25)),repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 11px,rgba(20,8,0,.14) 11px 12px,#0000 12px 27px),#6a3f22;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #4a2a15,inset 0 3px 0 rgba(255,220,180,.2)}
.desk.walnut>.f.s{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#6d4225 0 7px,#3a2213 7px 9px,#553219 9px)}
.desk.walnut>.f.s::before,.desk.walnut>.f.s::after{background-color:#5e391e;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #2e1a0c}
.desk.walnut>.f.w,.desk.walnut>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3a2213,#4d2e18)}
.counter>.f.t{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e7e1d6,#b9b1a4);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #948b7e}
.counter>.f.s,.counter>.f.e,.counter>.f.w{background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#6b4a2e 0 48px,#3e2a19 48px 50px)}
.chair-seat>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 40%,#3d3f47,#1f2026);border-radius:8px}
.chair-seat>.f.s,.chair-seat>.f.w,.chair-seat>.f.e{background:#16171b}
.chair-back{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1c1d22,#3a3c45 45%,#1c1d22);border-radius:12px 12px 6px 6px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #121317}
.chair-back::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:44%;width:12%;top:100%;height:12px;background:#16171b}
.chair-back.exec{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#3b1d12,#7a3d22 45%,#3b1d12);border-radius:16px 16px 8px 8px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #2a130a,inset 0 18px 0 -12px rgba(255,200,160,.18)}
.chair-pole{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#222,#666,#222)}
.chair-base{width:40px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(closest-side,#1b1b1f 0 30%,rgba(20,20,24,.0) 32%),conic-gradient(#222 0 8%,#0000 8% 20%,#222 20% 28%,#0000 28% 40%,#222 40% 48%,#0000 48% 60%,#222 60% 68%,#0000 68% 80%,#222 80% 88%,#0000 88%);opacity:.85}
.pot>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle,#3b2a1c 0 55%,#d9d4cb 58%);border-radius:4px}
.pot>.f.s,.pot>.f.w,.pot>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cfc8bc,#f0ebe3 40%,#b7afa3)}
.pot.terra>.f.s,.pot.terra>.f.w,.pot.terra>.f.e{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#9a4f2c,#c8714a 40%,#8a4426)}
.pot.terra>.f.t{background:radial-gradient(circle,#3b2a1c 0 55%,#b8633c 58%)}
.leaf{bottom:0;transform-origin:50% 100%;border-radius:50% 50% 45% 45%/70% 70% 30% 30%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1f5a2a 0 46%,#7dc57a 46% 52%,#2f7a37 52%);box-shadow:inset 0 -6px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.leaf.l2{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#2d6e30 0 47%,#9bd88f 47% 51%,#3f8e3f 51%)}
.leaf.snake{border-radius:50% 50% 10% 10%/90% 90% 10% 10%;background:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,#2e6b35 0 6px,#5a9a4e 6px 9px),#2e6b35;box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 #c9c56b,inset -3px 0 0 #c9c56b}

/* monitors */
.mon .bez{left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:calc(100% - 13px);background:#17181c;border-radius:4px;padding:3px;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(150,205,255,.35),inset 0 0 0 1px #2c2d33}
.mon .scr{position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1117}
.mon .neck{left:calc(50% - 3px);bottom:3px;width:6px;height:11px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1c1d21,#4a4b52,#1c1d21)}
.mon .foot{left:calc(50% - 15px);bottom:0;width:30px;height:4px;background:#24252a;border-radius:3px}
.mon.lap .bez{height:calc(100% - 5px);border-radius:3px 3px 0 0}
.mon.lap .neck{display:none}
.mon.lap .foot{left:-4px;width:calc(100% + 8px);height:5px;background:linear-gradient(#c7cbd2,#8a8f98);border-radius:0 0 3px 3px}
.scr .ln{left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:200%}
.scr.code .ln{background:
 conic-gradient(at 38% 2px,#0000 75%,#79c0ff 0) 4px 3px/100% 18px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 24% 2px,#0000 75%,#ff7b72 0) 10px 9px/100% 30px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 46% 2px,#0000 75%,#d2a8ff 0) 10px 15px/100% 42px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 30% 2px,#0000 75%,#7ee787 0) 16px 21px/100% 24px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 18% 2px,#0000 75%,#ffa657 0) 4px 6px/100% 36px repeat-y;animation:scroll 11s linear infinite}
.scr.term{background:#06110a}
.scr.term .ln{background:
 conic-gradient(at 60% 2px,#0000 75%,#4ade80 0) 3px 3px/100% 6px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 20% 2px,#0000 75%,#06110a 0) 40% 3px/100% 12px repeat-y;animation:scroll 6s linear infinite}
.scr.doc{background:#f5f1e8}
.scr.doc .ln{background:
 conic-gradient(at 70% 2px,#0000 75%,#9aa3ad 0) 5px 4px/100% 5px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 40% 2px,#0000 75%,#f5f1e8 0) 60% 4px/100% 20px repeat-y;animation:scroll 16s linear infinite}
.scr.dash{background:
 linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 4%,#1e293b 4% 31%,#0000 31% 36%,#1e293b 36% 63%,#0000 63% 68%,#1e293b 68% 96%,#0000 96%) 0 4px/100% 30% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#22d3ee 10% 70%,#0000 70%) 12% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#22d3ee 10% 90%,#0000 90%) 24% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#a78bfa 10% 55%,#0000 55%) 36% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#22d3ee 10% 100%) 48% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#f472b6 10% 80%,#0000 80%) 60% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#22d3ee 10% 95%,#0000 95%) 72% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#0000 0 10%,#facc15 10% 65%,#0000 65%) 84% 100%/7% 55% no-repeat,#0f172a}
.scr.dash .ln{height:30%;top:4px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 50%,#4ade80 0 2px,#0000 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%,#facc15 0 2px,#0000 3px),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 50%,#f472b6 0 2px,#0000 3px);animation:pulse 2.4s infinite}
.scr.chart{background:linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(255,255,255,.07) 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/100% 8px,#111827}
.scr.chart .ln{height:100%;background:
 linear-gradient(0deg,#34d399 0 100%) 10% 100%/9% 35% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#34d399 0 100%) 25% 100%/9% 50% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#34d399 0 100%) 40% 100%/9% 42% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#34d399 0 100%) 55% 100%/9% 64% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#34d399 0 100%) 70% 100%/9% 72% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(0deg,#fbbf24 0 100%) 85% 100%/9% 88% no-repeat;transform-origin:50% 100%;animation:grow 5s ease-in-out infinite}
.scr.insta{background:#fff;padding:3px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:2px}
.scr.insta b{position:relative;border-radius:1px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f9a8d4,#fb923c)}
.scr.insta b:nth-child(2){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#99f6e4,#38bdf8)}
.scr.insta b:nth-child(3){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fde68a,#f59e0b)}
.scr.insta b:nth-child(4){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#c4b5fd,#818cf8)}
.scr.insta b:nth-child(5){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#86efac,#14b8a6);animation:pulse 3s infinite}
.scr.insta b:nth-child(6){background:linear-gradient(135deg,#fecaca,#f43f5e)}
.scr.server{background:#0a0f0c}
.scr.server .ln{height:100%;background:
 radial-gradient(circle,#4ade80 0 1.6px,#0000 2.2px) 5px 3px/100% 7px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 70% 2px,#0000 75%,#3f5f4a 0) 14px 5px/100% 7px repeat-y;animation:pulse 1.4s steps(2) infinite}
.scr.check{background:#f8fafc}
.scr.check .ln{background:
 radial-gradient(circle,#22c55e 0 2.2px,#0000 2.8px) 6px 3px/100% 8px repeat-y,
 conic-gradient(at 62% 2px,#0000 75%,#94a3b8 0) 14px 6px/100% 8px repeat-y;animation:scroll 14s linear infinite}
.scr.cal{background:
 linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 8%,#fda4af 8% 30%,#0000 30%) 0 28%/100% 14% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 40%,#93c5fd 40% 70%,#0000 70%) 0 56%/100% 14% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 60%,#86efac 60% 92%,#0000 92%) 0 84%/100% 14% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(90deg,#e2e8f0 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/14.28% 100%,
 linear-gradient(#e2e8f0 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/100% 25%,
 linear-gradient(#0f766e 0 18%,#fff 18%)}
.scr.design{background:
 linear-gradient(#f472b6,#f472b6) 12% 22%/34% 40% no-repeat,
 radial-gradient(circle,#facc15 0 30%,#0000 32%) 70% 26%/40% 60% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(#38bdf8,#38bdf8) 60% 82%/58% 16% no-repeat,
 linear-gradient(90deg,#0000 0 86%,#27272a 86%),#fafaf9}
.scr.design .ln{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(#0000 0 30%,#a855f7 30% 36%,#0000 36%) 90% 0/6% 100% no-repeat,linear-gradient(#0000 0 50%,#22c55e 50% 56%,#0000 56%) 90% 0/6% 100% no-repeat;animation:pulse 2s infinite}
.scr.sheet{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#cbd5e1 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/20% 100%,linear-gradient(#cbd5e1 1px,#0000 1px) 0 0/100% 6px,linear-gradient(#16a34a 0 16%,#fff 16%)}

function layoutPlates(){

function route(a,dest){
 var pts=a.exit.map(function(p){return p.slice()}),my=a.aisle,last=pts[pts.length-1];
 var ax=dest.ax==null?dest.pt[0]:dest.ax;
 if(dest.aisle!==my){
  var mid=(last[0]+ax)/2,cx=Math.abs(CORR[0]-mid)<Math.abs(CORR[1]-mid)?CORR[0]:CORR[1];
  pts.push([cx,my],[cx,dest.aisle]);

  var t=a.path[0],dx=t[0]-a.x,dy=t[1]-a.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy),step=a.spd*dt;
  if(dist<=step){a.x=t[0];a.y=t[1];a.path.shift();if(!a.path.length){a.path=null;var r=a.done;a.done=null;if(r)r()}}
  else{a.x+=dx/dist*step;a.y+=dy/dist*step;
   if(Math.abs(dx)>Math.abs(dy)){a.el.classList.toggle('flip',dx<0);a.el.classList.remove('back')}
   else a.el.classList.toggle('back',dy<0);
  }
  place(a);
 }

 {pt:[92,548],aisle:575,ax:92,lines:['pausa pro café','esse café tá ótimo','alguém quer café?']},

 {pt:[230,56],aisle:300,ax:322,pre:[[322,56]],lines:['que dia bonito lá fora','olhando o movimento da rua']},

 if(b.desk){var d=b.desk,front=d.y+d.d+24;return {pt:[b.seat[0]+rand(-30,30),front],aisle:front<300?300:575,ax:null,host:b}}
